title: Entailment (Non-Contradiction) Test Scenarios
description: Facts that are paraphrases or entailments - should NOT be flagged as contradictions

ground_truth.text: Meridian Construction was founded in 2005 by a group of engineers.
James Carter is the CEO of Meridian Construction.
The company employs 500 people across three offices.
Sarah Miller was hired as a Safety Inspector in March 2020.
The project was completed on time and under budget.

test_facts.text: The founding of Meridian Construction took place in 2005.
test_facts.notes: Paraphrase of the founding - same meaning, different structure

test_facts.text: James Carter serves as Chief Executive Officer at Meridian Construction.
test_facts.notes: CEO = Chief Executive Officer - same meaning

test_facts.text: 500 employees work for the company in three different locations.
Sarah Miller joined Meridian as Safety Inspector in spring 2020.
test_facts.notes: hired = joined, March = spring - same meaning

test_facts.text: The project finished by the deadline without exceeding the allocated budget.

metadata.notes: These are false positive tests - none should be flagged as contradictions
